title: Cities of Refuge and Witnesses

questions.question: How many cities were initially to be set apart in the promised land?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 19:2 (ESV): "you shall set apart three cities for yourselves in the land..."

questions.question: Who may flee to these cities and live?
options: The manslayer who kills his neighbor unintentionally
questions.correctAnswer: The manslayer who kills his neighbor unintentionally
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 19:4 (ESV): "...the manslayer who kills his neighbor unintentionally without having hated him in the past..."

questions.question: What example is given of unintentional killing?
options: An ax head slipping from the handle while cutting wood
questions.correctAnswer: An ax head slipping from the handle while cutting wood
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 19:5 (ESV): "...as when... the ax head slips from the handle and strikes his neighbor so that he dies..."

questions.question: What should be done to a man who hates his neighbor and kills him deliberately?
options: Hand him over to the avenger of blood to die
Let him live in the city of refuge
questions.correctAnswer: Hand him over to the avenger of blood to die
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 19:11–12 (ESV): "...then the elders of his city shall send and take him from there, and hand him over to the avenger of blood, so that he may die."

questions.question: How many witnesses are required to establish a charge?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 19:15 (ESV): "A single witness shall not suffice... Only on the evidence of two witnesses or of three witnesses shall a charge be established."

questions.question: If the Lord enlarges the borders, how many more cities should be added?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 19:8–9 (ESV): "...then you shall add three other cities to these three..."

questions.question: Why are roads to be prepared to these cities?
options: Lest the avenger of blood pursue the manslayer and overtake him
questions.correctAnswer: Lest the avenger of blood pursue the manslayer and overtake him
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 19:6 (ESV): "lest the avenger of blood in hot anger pursue the manslayer and overtake him..."

questions.question: What is the law concerning landmarks?
options: You shall not move your neighbor's landmark
You can move them at night
Only the king can move them
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not move your neighbor's landmark
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 19:14 (ESV): "You shall not move your neighbor's landmark, which the men of old have set..."

questions.question: What is the punishment for a malicious witness who accuses falsely?
options: Do to him as he thought to do to his brother
questions.correctAnswer: Do to him as he thought to do to his brother
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 19:19 (ESV): "then you shall do to him as he had thought to do to his brother."

questions.question: What principle of retribution is stated here?
options: Life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth
questions.correctAnswer: Life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 19:21 (ESV): "Your eye shall not pity. It shall be life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot."

questions.question: Who are the judges in the case of a malicious witness?
options: The priests and the judges who are in office
questions.correctAnswer: The priests and the judges who are in office
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 19:17 (ESV): "...shall stand before the Lord, before the priests and the judges who are in office in those days."

questions.question: Why must innocent blood not be shed?
options: So the guilt of blood will not be upon you
Because the family will be angry
questions.correctAnswer: So the guilt of blood will not be upon you
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 19:10 (ESV): "lest innocent blood be shed... and so the guilt of bloodshed be upon you."

questions.question: Why is a single witness insufficient?
options: To prevent false accusation and ensure certainty
questions.correctAnswer: To prevent false accusation and ensure certainty
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 19:15 (ESV): "A single witness shall not suffice against a person for any crime..."

questions.question: How are the cities to be distributed?
options: Dividing the land territory into three parts
questions.correctAnswer: Dividing the land territory into three parts
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 19:3 (ESV): "...and divide into three parts the area of the land..."

questions.question: What if the avenger of blood kills the unintentional slayer before he reaches the city?
options: He is not guilty of blood if the slayer hadn't reached safety? (Actually text focuses on preventing this)
Wait, text says "lest he kill him... though he was not deserving of death". Context implies protecting the slayer.
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 19:6 implies the pursuit might be successful if the road is too long, resulting in the death of an innocent man ("not deserving of death").

key_verse_text: Lest innocent blood be shed in your land that the LORD your God is giving you for an inheritance, and so the guilt of bloodshed be upon you. (ESV)
